Service.Title: EFFIS
Service.Abstract: The European Forest Fire Information System (EFFIS) supports the services in charge of the protection of forests against fires in the EU countries and provides the European Commission services and the European Parliament with updated and reliable information on wildland fires in Europe.

Layer.Name: effis.nrt.ba
Layer.Title: viirs.ba
Layer.Abstract: The GWIS Near‑Real‑Time Burnt‑Area layer presents the extent of recent fire impact derived from the clustering of VIIRS thermal‑anomaly (hotspot) detections. Individual VIIRS hotspots are grouped in space and time to delineate contiguous burnt‑area polygons, which are then updated at each acquisition cycle (up to 14 passes per day). The product provides a synoptic view of actively burning and freshly extinguished surfaces across the European Union, supporting the European Forest Fire Information System (EFFIS) with timely information for fire‑risk assessment, situational awareness and operational response.
